MANGO ATHLETE / MANGO VISION

Built around
their journey.

Mango Athlete brings an athlete's games, availability, performance, and history together. Mango Vision is the companion sports-camera concept.

In development
Camera imagery is a design concept. Automated capture and AI analysis are planned capabilities, not verified hardware specifications.

A look at the experience
Profiles, statistics, and game imagery are illustrative. The optional sample video is stock footage from Mixkit, not footage from Mango Vision.

Made to explore
Move across the light, tap a chapter, use the arrow keys, or swipe. You can preview your own local video in Capture; it stays on your device.
